intent: A label/keyword chip, optionally linked and optionally removable. Use for labels on issues, filters, and topic chips. Plain text children render as a static chip; an <a> child makes it navigable; a .tag-remove button makes it dismissible.

structure.description: Optional link child; inherits chip color, underlines on hover.
Optional remove button rendered after the label; shows danger colors on hover. Must be a <button> for keyboard operability.

a11yNotes: Give .tag-remove an aria-label that names what it removes (e.g. aria-label="Remove frontend"), not just "Remove". The chip itself is non-interactive; interactivity lives on the inner <a>/<button> so it stays keyboard-reachable.
